info.name: TRADElogs — IB partner flow
info.description: The IB partner doc end to end: application, broker list, verification, packages, feature locks, grace, admin review. Run with apps/api/postman/run-ib.sh against a disposable database.

item.name: Application needs a valid social URL
Honey applies with brokers, socials and a pitch
Asking for info needs a reason → 409

exec: pm.test("message carries the note", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().error.message).to.include('Xellion IB id'); });
pm.test("reviewNote", () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('NEEDS_INFO'); pm.expect(d.reviewNote).to.eql('Send your Xellion IB id'); });

pm.test("xellion + other, all methods", () => { const x = d.catalog.find(c => c.key === 'xellion'); pm.expect(x.methods).to.eql(['LIST','SHEET','API']); pm.expect(d.catalog.map(c => c.key)).to.include('other'); pm.expect(d.brokers).to.eql([]); });

item.name: API method: connection waits for its API setup

exec: pm.test("pending, key stored", () => { pm.expect(d.method).to.eql('API'); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(d.hasApiKey).to.eql(true); });

item.name: Sheet must be a Google Sheets link → 422
Other broker needs a server match → 422

exec: pm.test("pending, no accounts", () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PENDING'); pm.expect(d.accountCount).to.eql(0); pm.expect(d.hasApiKey).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("3 added, 1 skipped", () => { pm.expect([d.added, d.updated, d.removed, d.skipped]).to.eql([3,0,0,1]); pm.expect(d.broker.status).to.eql('OK'); pm.expect(d.broker.accountCount).to.eql(3); });

item.name: Before connecting: partner shown, nothing to verify

exec: pm.test("no accounts, no packages", () => { pm.expect(d.accounts).to.eql([]); pm.expect(d.packages).to.eql([]); });

pm.test("t1 verified by account number", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(a.brokerKey).to.eql('xellion'); pm.expect(a.reason).to.eql(null); pm.expect(a.canRetry).to.eql(false); });
pm.test("t2 not in the list, with a reason and a retry", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('NOT_FOUND'); pm.expect(a.reason).to.include('isn’t in'); pm.expect(a.canRetry).to.eql(true); });
pm.test("t3 at a broker Honey has not connected", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('UNSUPPORTED_BROKER'); pm.expect(a.brokerKey).to.eql('exness'); pm.expect(a.reason).to.include('Exness'); });

item.name: t2 gives the broker email → review, not verified

exec: pm.test("3 client accounts, 1 verified", () => { const x = d.brokers[0]; pm.expect(x.clientAccounts).to.eql(2); pm.expect(x.verified).to.eql(1); });

item.name: Packages page lists perks and brokers

exec: pm.test("2 packages, perk catalog, xellion", () => { pm.expect(d.packages.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(d.perks.map(p => p.key)).to.include('signalx'); pm.expect(d.brokers).to.eql([{ key: 'xellion', label: 'Xellion' }]); });

pm.test("Starter active, Pro not listed (draft)", () => { const s = d.packages.find(p => p.name === 'Starter'); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(s.perks[0].key).to.eql('signalx'); pm.expect(d.packages.some(p => p.name === 'Pro')).to.eql(false); });

item.name: t2 sees why Starter is locked

exec: pm.test("locked with the reason", () => { const s = d.packages.find(p => p.name === 'Starter'); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('LOCKED'); pm.expect(s.reasons.join(' ')).to.include('Verify a broker account'); });
pm.test("live, nobody active yet", () => { pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('LIVE'); pm.expect(d.holders).to.eql(0); });

item.name: t1 sees the activity rule on Pro

exec: pm.test("Pro locked until they trade", () => { const p = d.packages.find(x => x.name === 'Pro'); pm.expect(p.status).to.eql('LOCKED'); pm.expect(p.reasons.join(' ')).to.include('Trade at least 1 closed trade in the last 30 days'); });

pm.test("nothing locked, 1 trade / 30 days", () => { pm.expect(d).to.eql({ activeMinTrades: 1, activeWindowDays: 30, activeMinLots: 0, graceDays: 7, partnerGraceDays: 7, lockedPerks: [], ibApiHosts: [] }); });

item.name: With nothing locked SignalX is open to t2
Admin locks SignalX to package holders
t2 access page lists the lock

exec: const v = d.find(x => x.kind === 'verification' && x.account && x.account.login === '7001002');

pm.test("t2 in review with the email signal", () => { pm.expect(v.signal).to.eql('email-match'); pm.expect(v.brokerEmail).to.eql('vikram.broker@mail.test'); pm.expect(v.partner.name).to.eql(pm.variables.get('honeyName')); });

item.name: t2 now holds Starter and passes the lock

exec: pm.test("verified manually, Starter active", () => { pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(d.packages.find(p => p.name === 'Starter').status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(d.myPerks).to.include('signalx'); });

item.name: A list re-check doesn’t undo the admin decision
t1’s Starter moves to grace (partner grace = 3 days)

exec: pm.test("grace with an end date and the reason", () => { const s = d.packages.find(p => p.name === 'Starter'); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('GRACE'); const days = (Date.parse(s.graceUntil) - Date.now()) / 864e5; pm.expect(days).to.be.within(2.9, 3.01); pm.expect(s.reasons.join(' ')).to.include('paused'); pm.expect(d.partner.status).to.eql('PAUSED'); });

item.name: Grace ends → the scheduled pass suspends
t1’s Starter is suspended after grace

exec: pm.test("suspended, lock applies", () => { const s = d.packages.find(p => p.name === 'Starter'); pm.expect(s.status).to.eql('SUSPENDED'); pm.expect(d.myPerks).to.not.include('signalx'); });

item.name: t4 has no partner and can join
t4 joins Honey with her code
Partner clients: P&L hidden without consent

exec: pm.test("t1 verified + eligible, P&L null", () => { pm.expect(c.ib.verification).to.eql('VERIFIED'); pm.expect(c.ib.eligible).to.eql(true); pm.expect(c.ib.consent).to.eql(false); pm.expect(c.ib.pnl30d).to.eql(null); });
pm.test("t4 came in late", () => { pm.expect(d.items.find(x => x.name === pm.variables.get('t4Name')).via).to.eql('late'); });

item.name: Partner overview carries the IB funnel

exec: pm.test("4 signups, 3 connected, 2 verified, 2 eligible", () => { const f = d.ib.funnel; pm.expect([f.signups, f.connected, f.verified, f.eligible]).to.eql([4, 3, 2, 2]); });
pm.test("Honey row", () => { pm.expect([r.clients, r.connected, r.verified, r.eligible]).to.eql([4, 3, 2, 2]); });

item.name: Admin clients include P&L regardless of consent

exec: pm.test("syncs, verifications, access and consent recorded", () => { const k = d.map(e => e.kind); ['ib.connect','ib.sync','verify.verified','verify.manual_approve','access.grant','access.grace','consent.on','referral.late_code'].forEach(x => pm.expect(k).to.include(x)); });

pm.test("csv with a header and t1", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Content-Type')).to.include('text/csv'); const txt = pm.response.text(); pm.expect(txt.split('\n')[0]).to.include('verification'); pm.expect(txt).to.include(pm.variables.get('t1Email')); });

item.name: t1 is no longer verifiable and Starter goes to grace
Integration gives a secret postback URL

exec: pm.test("url with a long token", () => { pm.expect(d.postbackUrl).to.match(/\/api\/ib\/postback\/[A-Za-z0-9_-]{30,}$/); pm.expect(d.postbackParams.map(p => p.name)).to.include('account_id'); });

item.name: A 300 KB list uploads (body limit raised for lists)

exec: let rows = ['Account ID,Email','7001001,tara@broker.test']; for (let i = 0; i < 14000; i++) rows.push(String(8100000 + i) + ',bulk' + i + '@mail.test'); pm.collectionVariables.set('bigList', JSON.stringify({ text: rows.join('\n'), mode: 'replace' }));

item.name: Unknown event is logged and ignored
Registration postback for an MT4 account

exec: pm.test("kinds recorded", () => { const k = d.events.map(e => e.kind); ['registration','trade','commission','deposit','unknown'].forEach(x => pm.expect(k).to.include(x)); });

item.name: Partner earnings show reported IB commission only

exec: pm.test("listed but needs a human", () => { pm.expect(a.kind).to.eql('external'); pm.expect(a.platform).to.eql('MT4'); pm.expect(a.status).to.eql('MANUAL_REVIEW'); pm.expect(a.reason).to.include('isn’t connected'); });

item.name: Someone else can’t claim the same account

exec: const v = d.find(x => x.kind === 'verification' && x.account && x.account.login === '7002001');

item.name: Omar is verified, active, and holds Starter
An empty tool can’t be submitted → 422
Admin downloads the EA to inspect
Not in a package yet → client 404
Honey adds both tools to Starter

exec: pm.test("2 tools", () => { pm.expect(d.products.map(p => p.name).sort()).to.eql(['Honey EA', 'Honey Ribbon']); });

pm.test("opens counted", () => { const p = d.find(x => x.name === 'Honey Ribbon'); pm.expect(p.opens30d).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(p.users30d).to.eql(1); pm.expect(p.packages).to.include('Starter'); });

item.name: Changing approved code needs a new review
Until then clients only see the EA
Admin turns tools off for Honey

exec: pm.test("active, nothing to pay", () => { pm.expect(k.status).to.eql('ACTIVE'); pm.expect(k.reasons).to.eql([]); pm.expect(k).to.not.have.property('canSubscribe'); pm.expect(d).to.not.have.property('paymentsEnabled'); });
pm.test("grace with the reason", () => { pm.expect(k.status).to.eql('GRACE'); pm.expect(k.reasons.join(' ')).to.include('paused'); });

pm.test("daily series with every step", () => { pm.expect(d.daily.length).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(d.daily.reduce((n, x) => n + x.signups, 0)).to.eql(4); pm.expect(d.daily.reduce((n, x) => n + x.verified, 0)).to.be.at.least(3); });
pm.test("package holders", () => { const v = d.marketplace.packageSubs.find(p => p.name === 'VIP'); pm.expect(v.active).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(v).to.not.have.property('revenueCents'); });
pm.test("IB earnings by month", () => { pm.expect(d.earningsByMonth.reduce((n, m) => n + m.ib, 0)).to.eql(38); pm.expect(d.earningsByMonth[0]).to.not.have.property('salesShareCents'); });

item.name: Partner CSV keeps P&L private without consent

exec: pm.test("VIP with holders", () => { const v = d.find(p => p.name === 'VIP'); pm.expect(v.partner).to.eql(pm.variables.get('honeyName')); pm.expect(v.holders).to.be.at.least(1); });
pm.test("kinds", () => { const k = d.map(e => e.kind); ['product.approve','package.hold','package.release','partner.terms','account.external_add'].forEach(x => pm.expect(k).to.include(x)); });
